channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Sabres Might Have Dodged A $6.5-Million Bullet In Losing Out On Colton Parayko
item.description: Buffalo's Plan B of acquiring Logan Stanley and Luke Schenn allows the team to go deep in the playoffs, while also saving some cap space to re-sign pending UFA Alex Tuch.

item.title: Longtime NHL Star Corey Perry Could Continue His Rare Run Of Cup Final Appearances With Lightning
item.description: The Tampa Bay Lightning brought back Corey Perry. Will Perry be one of the pieces of the puzzle who brings the Lightning another Cup, or will he be on the wrong side of the Cup final once again?

item.title: NHL Waivers: Canucks, Flyers And Panthers Claim Players On Trade Deadline Day
item.description: The Canucks, Flyers and Panthers claimed players off NHL waivers from the Lightning, Devils and Golden Knights.

item.title: Sign Of Things To Come? Maple Leafs Win TSN Mock Draft Lottery — And Select Gavin McKenna With No. 1 Pick
item.description: "We legitimately dropped ping pong balls," TSN host James Duthie said as the Toronto Maple Leafs won its mock draft lottery.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Reacting To The NHL Trade Deadline Live
item.description: Katie Gaus, Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos go live to recap the NHL trade deadline. Who are the winners and losers? What did the Cup contenders do?

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline: With Brayden Schenn, The New York Islanders Are Back
item.description: The New York Islanders are a playoff contender after being trade deadline sellers last season. They acquired center Brayden Schenn from the St. Louis Blues.

item.title: Why The Avalanche Bringing Back Nazem Kadri Is So Significant In The NHL's Central Division Battle
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche brought back Nazem Kadri, one of the centers who helped them win the Stanley Cup in 2022. Their center depth is now very strong in a division with two other Cup contenders.

item.title: Blues GM Blasts Parayko Trade Offer Leaking Before He Declined To Waive No-Trade Clause
item.description: St. Louis Blues GM Doug Armstrong told reporters they did some due diligence as soon as reports came out about an agreement in place to trade Colton Parayko to the Buffalo Sabres, which the D-man later struck down.

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline 2026: The Five Biggest Winners
item.description: The NHL's trade deadline passed Friday afternoon. Five teams had the best performance, including buyers and sellers.

item.title: Penguins' Evgeni Malkin Suspended Five Games For Slashing Sabres' Dahlin
item.description: Evgeni Malkin slashed Rasmus Dahlin in the head during Thursday's game between the Pittsburgh Penguins and Buffalo Sabres.
